horoscopes.horoscope: You have your hands full today. There will be planning, meetings and a lot of work to do. You may feel tired and dejected due to insufficient inputs from others. However, Ganesha says things will become clear slowly as matters come to a conclusion. Managing emotional stress would be a challenge. You need to pay attention to your lover’s feelings. You should not use any harsh words to your partner. Adjustments in love life will make it much more successful. You will feel peaceful for being with your partner. It is likely that you won’t feel happy today. You may become negative in your thinking. Though health won’t suffer, if you remain under the dark shadow of negativity, you will end up falling sick. You are advised to stay objective about things. You won’t see scope of fresh start of new financial budget in the nearer future and you will feel as if you are trapped in something that you cannot come out from. You need to put in more efforts. You tend to make everyone happy today. Hence, you will be responsible and may have to compromise your own wishes. You will involve in creative projects, keeping aside the technical assignment. You like to sort out the complexities of the projects. Therefore, even small issues will take a lot of time.

You may feel let down as your folks may not extend the support you expected from them, says Ganesha You should try to remain practical and not get swayed by emotions. It is highly likely that family feuds may erupt today. Ganesha advises you to avoid confrontations and keep smiling to emerge a winner. You may not dominate in love life though you tend to take a commanding position. You will try your best to keep your partner emotionally attached to you. Expression through painting or singing might be in your mind. You may not get a positive reply today but surely in the future. It’s a good day for your health. This is also a good day to start doing regular exercise and increase your energy level or boost your resistance power. On the whole, the day is going to pass without any challenges on the health front. If you are in job, you will have two better paying jobs on your way. If you are in business, you will have two or more business deals coming your way. This is the right time to ask your friends to help you. Today you may be looking forward to easy gains. Minimum efforts and shortcuts may give you success but not satisfaction. You may not be able to focus on your prime responsibilities and thus the gossips in the office may attract you. Make sure that the important works get finished in time.

Today, you will decide to become a bit more conscious about your health. You may or may not enrol yourself into a gym and measure your calories, but you will be concerned about your lifestyle and food habits today, predicts Ganesha. That’s quite unlike a Piscean. It is the perfect time for love. So go out with your honey and enjoy the nice evening. Gorging on your desired ice cream with your sweetheart will boost your relationship. A fun-filled evening will be on the cards, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees, that you’ll stay focused at work now. You may get stressed in taking instant decisions. But gradually you shall receive praise for your excellence in work. Try to be understanding towards personal matters. Health looks decent. Stay calm and plan your schedule properly. Ganesha feels that you will worry too much about matters which will be very confusing on the financial front. You should listen to the advise of a well-wisher on your work-related matters today. Your confidence might remain low today. You want to be a perfectionist in whatever you do but it doesn’t seem to happen because confusions will affect your mind in the first half of the day. Fortunately, as the day progresses, you will regain your confidence and take proper decisions.

Today, you are likely to be brimming with love and compassion. However, certain negative thoughts will spoil all your good work. But don’t fret! Your efforts won’t go wasted and you will get the desired results sooner or later, says Ganesha. You may have a merry time with the one closer to your heart. The creativity you nurture today will help you express your love for your beloved in a truly dramatic way. You tend to be special in the eyes of your beloved. Work life seems progressive. But, you might face trouble in taking a major decision today. Ganesha suggests, you to be calm and positive, as being emotionally sensitive can affect your mood adversely. Health front looks good now. Some creative work shall help in uplifting your mood. Rather than heeding your intellect, you should just follow your heart. Decisions taken instinctively today will be have a positive impact on your finances, assures Ganesha. The day will turn out to be quite interesting if you make use of your sixth sense. It is the perfect time for unconventional tasks. Your creative mind may not let you be practical. You may come up with different ways to solve problems. This is not the good day to invest money in a big project.

Working hard, or hardly working — there is a vast difference between the two. You would be wiser to be working hard today, especially if it is success that you desire, says Ganesha. Remember that there is no substitute for hard work, and the sooner you realise this, the better. So sweat it out today. Also, hard work always pays its dividends, so, after a long day at work, you can look forward to an enchanting evening with your love. The night shall be exceptionally memorable, hints Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bright Yellow It will be a romantic evening with your honey and it will give you the opportunity to face the most important meeting. It will be an enjoyable night with your sweetheart once you will be in a big movie hall or a splendid restaurant. Ganesha foresees that you need to focus on your priorities, or else your energy might get consumed in unproductive areas. You shall maintain cordial relations with your work mates, as you’ll need their assistance later. Health needs care now, Join some sports activities. You need to consult some financial experts if you are confused about how to handle your funds today. It may be that you need to take a few risks, but ensure that they are judicious risks. Today you may have to fight and overcome the frustration that may come your way due to your inability to finish work in time. Ganesha feels that you will not give up in such a situation and may work hard to achieve the desired results.

The bulb of ideas will burn bright today. A possible see-saw between your contractual obligation and current duties may baffle you. New contacts will stand you in good stead. Blood will prove thicker, and family and friends will consolidate their place in your life. You will find it difficult to please your spouse. If you want to see your spouse happy, you need to fulfill at least some of his/her demands. You may have to excite your loved one or may take to a place that captures the attention of your partner. You believe in living life in a more organized way, hence your new plans will get acknowledged by all the new people you’ll be dealing with today. This shall boost up your confidence level. Health will remain fine. Keep a check on your daily diet, feels Ganesha. Today is favourable if you are planning on expanding your horizons, and turning towards the stock market. Avoid doing business with strangers, and if you are a professional, look around for better options. You might feel that you are not using your intellect for the right work. You may be crazy for the most demanding work that attracts the attention of your boss and superiors. If you continue working in the direction of your goal, you will find a solution to each and every problem.

Your instincts are at their peak today. Generally, this means a lot of good, but for you, it may also mean having to put up with the trouble of small things bothering you in a big way. So, it becomes highly important for you to remain balanced and focused. Do so and you may produce wonderful results at work, and also look forward to raking in the money from various sources, says Ganesha. You may wish to end this tiring but satisfactory day by spending a wonderful time with your beloved. Your beloved too will be in a good mood today. This is a brilliant opportunity to show your sincerity. Talk to your partner and plan for a memorable evening, suggests Ganesha. Ganesha says, that your health is going to be satisfactory now. You may feel exhausted due to hectic schedule at work. But try to avoid fatigue as it may affect your health and mood. Try to prefer light diet as it will help in imptoving your health. Ganesha advises you not to waste money behind upgrading your vehicle unless it is absolutely necessary. Doing things just because someone else has will only dry up your reserves of savings. You will remain totally committed to your profession, says Ganesha. You will be praised for all the moral qualities. Your work habit, ability to handle crisis, compassionate nature, everything will be highly appreciated. Managing complexities will be heavy for you, feels Ganesha.

Ganesha predicts today will be a day full of focus and a clear thought process. The clarity of thought you have has been acquired over a period of time, says Ganesha, and that could make all the difference. A crisp application of thoughts to ideas and actions will bring much appreciation from bosses and peers. Romance is in the air and you will have a wonderful time with the one you love. You will discuss romantic talks that will catch all the attention of your partner. It may even lead to the passionate affairs post dinner. Your mind will be very sensitive today but it would be better if you convert this sensitivity into something creative. You will be able to think deeply about various aspects of life. By-and-large, Ganesha finds this day to be positive for you. If you have invested in the stock market but you are not serious about trading, start trading because it will give you huge returns. Those who are already in stock market, do not need any advise. Ganesha is happy to tell you that your positive qualities will come to the fore today. You will remain so occupied in work that you may even forget lunch. Everyone in the office will notice your involvement in work. You will draw inspiration from others.

Settling for a new, better employment will help you fast-track your career growth. A telephonic interview might ring in a new offer. A lucrative deal with an MNC would serve well. Your dedication and devotion to work will also peak today, says Ganesha. Spending a quality time with your beloved will be the priority, foretells Ganesha. You are bound to please him/her. Exploring an eco-friendly destination will be in your mind. The relationship will remain good since you can trust your partner, feels Ganesha. Do not let your emotions surface as they may surface in a wrong way and it might affect your relations with others. You are likely to get irritated very fast. You are suggested not to do any task that’s stressful for you. If you are planning to see new houses for investment purpose or even if you want to shift to new house the day is really favourable. While at it, you might also you think about upgrading your vehicle. You are a thorough professional who does not let anything come between you and your job. Today, domestic responsibilities may keep demanding your attention. You have to be practically sound today. A call from home may bother you, but you will have to keep calm.

You will find the day to be taxing, mostly because of the amount of work delegated to you, says Ganesha. But it will take trouble quite an effort to dampen your spirit. You will be in the fray in the latter part of the day, but will leave your rivals trailing behind in terms of business strategies. Success will be yours if you ensure to be mindful of your moves. You will discuss balancing professional and personal life with your beloved. Stability, commitment, and practicality will be the three most important parameters which you need to judge your current relationship. You may encourage creative approach in your spouse. However, you will ensure a harmonious relationship. You are likely to be mentally more active today. Chances of getting carried away by emotions would be lesser, which will keep you safe and better placed. Ganesha feels that this is the right day to plan short distance trip to rejuvenate. Ganesha feels that today, you will be earning as per routine and there won’t be any additional or substantial financial income. You are a powerful calculator. You can calculate gains and losses on finger tips. You may finish working on the first level of the project you are handling. You will want to jump to the second stage immediately. Ganesha advises you check all the steps once again. The day is perfect for reviewing everything as this will help you decide the path ahead.

You may huff and puff, but today is not the day when you’ll finish what you started. Don’t lose heart, the future is promising. Take a break, says Ganesha, you’ve worked enough. The results are on the way. A sweet romantic get-together is on the cards. You tend to relate well to your partner. You will even learn to appreciate your beloved. You may plan to attend a musical event or want to spend maximum time in a museum or art gallery with music in the background. You are not likely to face any health issue. Your day is going to be good today. Majority of tasks that you would be handling today will be need based. It is better to avoid taking initiatives today, says Ganesha. Some challenges on the financial front are foreseen today. You will be able to earn well but at the same time, family’s requirement will be such that you have to spend money on that matter or on that family member. You should not be upset if you feel a little unlucky today. You like to work at time and environment convenient to you. You might have to perform well within a limited time in a given environment. However, Ganesha is happy that you will successfully handle this challenge.

You are likely to be grinding yourself under at the workplace today. A turning point will arise in romantic liaisons, though if the evening awaiting you is anything to go by, it is something you should welcome wholeheartedly, says Ganesha. Your helping nature will please your family and beloved feels Ganesha. Your spouse is all set to shower all his/her love upon you. Managing the most difficult situation will now be easy with the love and support of your partner, feels Ganesha. You will be more inclined towards spiritual and sacrificing spirit today. Besides, health will be impacted if you grow sensitive. You should have more liquid diet today. That will help maintain water level in body and will leave good impact on your health, advises Ganesha. This is an ideal day to earn goodwill by helping others. If someone needs more money than you, Ganesha feels that you will be ready to let go. At the same time, see to it that you are not being taken for a ride. A positive change in your personality is foreseen. Your emotional bond with your colleagues and the organization you work for will strengthen today. You will be ready to help everyone out with their problems. You may like to bring the smart approach to tackling difficult issues.
